briefing: Jupiter is the biggest planet of all.
You could fit every other planet inside it.
It has no ground to land on, only clouds in stripes of orange, white, and brown.
A giant storm called the great red spot has been spinning for hundreds of years.
Jupiter has so many moons that we are still counting, so keep your distance: even its gravity is big.
preflightLine: Jupiter's pull is strong. More rocks, faster rocks. Keep your eyes on the words, not the storm.
warpSentence: Jupiter is the biggest planet of all.
beaconFlavor: Big enough to hide the whole map. We found it anyway.
